project.name: Inspecto — Predictive Analytics (optional)
project.description: OPTIONAL add-on module (PREDICTIVE-ANALYTICS-1, add-on predictiveAnalytics, Standard and above per OD-5). First slice PREDICTIVE-SEGMENT-RFM-1: the segmentation-model component kind (SegmentationModel, validated fail closed by SegmentationKindValidator, with the reserved customer_segments_ output stores), the pure RFM segmenter (RfmSegmenter: quantile bins from the Analytics Kernel, a declared label table) and the predict.segment Job Type (SegmentJobType / SegmentEvaluator) writing customer_segments_{model} and _latest through the score output contract. The RFM inputs are windowed Measures (MeasureCompiler window + recency, ANALYTICS-CORE-1 C1). Second slice PREDICTIVE-CHURN-DECLARED-1: the churn-model kind (ChurnModel / ChurnKindValidator, reserved churn_scores_ stores) and the predict.churn Job Type (ChurnJobType / ChurnEvaluator / ChurnScorer): a declared-coefficient logistic score with per-input contributions, insufficient below minHistoryDays. Third slice PREDICTIVE-FORECAST-1: the forecast-model kind (ForecastModel / ForecastKindValidator, reserved forecasts_ stores) and the predict.forecast Job Type (ForecastJobType / ForecastEvaluator / Forecaster): seasonal-naive and Holt-Winters per series with an interval and the stored backtest error. PredictionRoutes (GET /predictions/{kind}/{model}/{entityKey}). Package com.gamma.predictive. THIN: no shade. Built only under the edition-standard / -advanced / -preview profiles.
